premium.basis: Closing price on August 5, 2024, the last trading day before the final offer was submitted and accepted.

value_inflection_events.event: Unfavorable Phase 3 PRESERVE 1 CRC Trial results announced, leading to trial discontinuation.
Interim TNBC Trial Data announced, recommending continuation of the Phase 3 trial.
Unfavorable Final TNBC Trial Data (PRESERVE 2) results announced.
Announcement of all-cash acquisition by Pharmacosmos A/S at $7.15/share.

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors were identified in financial news or market reporting services prior to the definitive announcement.

notes: The deal followed a prolonged strategic review triggered by a failed pivotal CRC trial, with a final auction leading to an 81% premium over the unaffected pre-announcement price.
